page.notes: Line numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 are printed in the left margin and are transcribed as notes. The big initial I of the first paragraph is joined to the following "Urisprudentia" as "Iurisprudentia". The run-on lead-in "Adpraceptumprimum." is printed without a space and is copied as printed. Long s is read as plain s throughout (e.g. "est" for "eft", "potest" for "poteft"). Line-end hyphen in "litigan-" is printed and the word continues on the next page; "tium," at the foot right is the catchword. Edge marks at the left and right margins are not transcribed.
